mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students(name, kana_name, nickname, email, area, age, sex, remark, deleted) VALUES (#{name}, #{kanaName}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{area}, #{age}, #{sex}, #{remark}, false)
INSERT INTO students_courses(student_id, course_name, start_date, end_date) VALUES(#{studentId}, #{courseName}, #{startDate}, #{endDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE students SET name=#{name},kana_name=#{kanaName},nickname=#{nickname}, email=#{email}, area=#{area}, age=#{age}, sex=#{sex}, remark=#{remark}, telephone=#{telephone}, deleted=#{deleted} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE students_courses SET course_name = #{courseName} WHERE id =#{id}
